Sandbox_B47ANCEDEyewear_TyingEnabled_too: Allow new eyewear and supported hat ties. Existing ties remain effective and can always be untied. Server setting.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEyewear_EyewearFallMulti: Multiply the default fall values for untied eyewear, including monocles. Range 0.25–5; default 1. Updates worn eyewear without changing tied items. Server setting.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEyewear_StrappedHeadwear: Fall value for supported strapped protective headwear. Range 0–100; default 0. The vanilla impact calculation still applies. Server setting.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEyewear_WearableRetainer: Allow crafting and protection from reusable wearable retainers. Disabling removes their protection; existing items can still be taken off and kept. Server setting.
Fall value for the one compatible untied pair protected by a worn retainer. Range 0–100; default 0 prevents knock-off. Uses vanilla impact rules and has no per-catch durability. Server setting.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEyewear_RareRetainerLoot: Server/SP chance per eligible container fill with room for the item: default 0.25%, range 0–5%, precision 0.01%. Zero disables new spawns. School lockers, optical-store containers and pharmacy cabinets only. Existing filled containers and existing retainer items are unchanged. Wearable retainers must be enabled.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEyewear_ImprovisedTieWea: Server setting: each eligible vanilla head/clothing damage attempt has a 1-in-N chance to remove one of 10 native condition points. Range 1–100, integer steps; default 1. Larger values last longer. Applies to existing worn items without repairing them. Not a knock-off counter; the rare unbreakable retainer is exempt.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEyewear_ClothRetainerWea: Server setting: each eligible vanilla head/clothing damage attempt has a 1-in-N chance to remove one of 10 native condition points. Range 1–100, integer steps; default 2. Larger values last longer. Applies to existing worn items without repairing them. Not a knock-off counter; the rare unbreakable retainer is exempt.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEyewear_LeatherRetainerW: Server setting: each eligible vanilla head/clothing damage attempt has a 1-in-N chance to remove one of 10 native condition points. Range 1–100, integer steps; default 4. Larger values last longer. Applies to existing worn items without repairing them. Not a knock-off counter; the rare unbreakable retainer is exempt.
